text:
maria: Heads up — canary rollout of model v4 on /chat-route is showing a token-tail latency regression vs v3. p95 fine, but p99 and p999 jumped ~45% last 10m :frowning:

alex: Do we have the model_version dimension on the token-level waterfall? can you paste the panel link?

maria: yup, panel here: https://console.redwood/ops/dash/model-compare?route=/chat-route&panel=token_waterfall — see spikes around 15:12 UTC. kv_cache_hit_rate for v4 dropped from ~0.9 -> 0.38 at the same time.

priyanka: hmm suspicious. last night we landed the kernel-selection tweak that prefers fused_kv when seq_len>64. could be falling back incorrectly and invalidating KV sharing.

alex: can you share the short promql and the trace id for one slow request? want to check whether batching shape changed or an extra memcpy shows up in the waterfall.

maria: promql we used: ```promql
sum by (model_version) (histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, model_version)))
```
trace id: trace:9f2c4b (linked in thread).

sam: I pulled the pprof flame for one slow sample — high time in cudaMemcpy + kernel_selector. The timeline shows kernel-selection path executing per-token at token 12 and then a sync.

priyanka: that fits. the new selector has a fallback path that does a correctness check on KV layout for some quantized kernels; if that check triggers we rewrite KV pointers which forces a memcpy. that would kill tail latency.

alex: actionable: add a per-route per-model_version KV-eviction/pointer-change metric so we can correlate. also add a 'kernel_fallbacks' counter exposed from runtime (label: reason).

maria: created a temporary dashboard tile: ModelVersion -> KV pointer churn, KernelFallbacks, Token p999. linked at https://console.redwood/ops/dash/temp/1767778000

perf-bot: Deploy event: canary v4 -> 6/10 hosts @ 15:10 UTC by @ci. (reaction :rocket:)

sam: For immediate mitigation we can revert selector change on canary hosts or force v3 routing for /chat-route. which should we do?

alex: prefer routing fallback to v3 for that route while we triage. easier and lower blast radius. set emergency route rule and monitor.

maria: done — pinned route to v3 for /chat-route canary group at 15:22 UTC. p999 back to baseline within 2 mins.

priyanka: I'm going to add unit tests to kernel-selector and a lighter correctness check that doesn't rebind pointers. will push a fix + perf test.

maria: thanks. follow-up items: 1) add kernel_fallbacks metric and KV-pointer-churn counter (alex/sam), 2) permanent model-compare dashboard with per-route breakdown and ability to slice by batch_shape and kv_hit_bucket (maria), 3) selector fix + perf tests (priyanka). I'll open a short RFC and we can sync tomorrow in ops-standup.

alex: great. please paste RFC link when ready. if anyone sees another spike, @here. :mag:
